mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand for goods and services, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < -0.2pp MoM) indicate labor market strength that fuels consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS increases >0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases >0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during late-cycle expansion signals supply chain stress that reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% indicates persistent price pressures that trigger anticipated rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST > 0.5% MoM) and retail sales (RSAFS > 0.3% MoM) signals robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS increases > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by the specified thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation and triggers preemptive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.
